statements.status_notes: CVE-2017-17973 reports a heap use-after-free in t2p_writeproc() in tools/tiff2pdf.c of LibTIFF 4.0.8 (https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2017-17973). The original report was never confirmed: the CVE record notes a third-party report that it cannot be reproduced, Debian lists no affected tiff version and records that the reporter did not confirm the details after several attempts (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2017-17973), and no upstream libtiff fix is identified for this CVE. Pending: a reproduction against the tiff2pdf this package ships, or an upstream ruling, to establish whether the report describes a real defect in LibTIFF 4.7.0, which this package builds.
